title: 第二十三章 赌对了第二十四章 武家来人
lines: 合宫县衙一支令箭便将武攸敏打入了大牢，全县轰动，百姓们奔走相告，纷纷叫好，一时新任合宫县主薄傅游艺声名大涨。
傅游艺年过六旬，本来就有长者之相，这一次他又果决果断，坚决抓武攸敏，合宫县老百姓大感解气，一时傅青天的称号竟然在县里叫开了。
傅游艺现在是既痛苦又快乐，快乐自然是他的声名上去了，下一步他的大计可以施展了。痛苦则是，他抓了武家的人，很快就会有麻烦上门，到时候他该怎么应对？
倘若应对不好，那可就要堕入万劫不复之境，他这一辈子的前途就全完了呢！
所以，这几天傅游艺几乎是和岳峰泡在了一起，岳峰成了他的救命稻草了！
“岳兄弟，你放心，这一次事了我一定举荐你为县尉，亦或者我举荐你去京城考进士，得功名，从此也成为士人。
自我见岳兄弟第一眼，便知道兄弟绝非常人，果然，以岳兄弟之才，他日必能为国之栋梁，我傅某人有责任为国举荐贤才……”
傅游艺口若悬河，把岳峰捧得很高，什么英雄不问出处之类的恭维话像是不要钱似的往外蹦。
岳峰只是淡淡笑笑，道：“朱恩既然去了东都，这个时候也该要回来了！我相信，县尊大人一定也回来了，还希望傅大人做好准备，立刻去见姚县尊。”
傅游艺一拍手，道：“对了！大事儿差点忘记了，姚县尊回来必然在后院的蹴鞠场，岳兄弟，你我一起去见县尊大人！”
岳峰跟在傅游艺后面，一起到了后院的蹴鞠场，发现县臣魏生明早就到了，魏生明眯眼盯着傅游艺，嘴角微微翘起，眼神中尽是冷意。
傅游艺暗叫一声不好，还没等他说话，姚云山一脚揣在蹴鞠球上，将皮球踹得稀巴烂，道：“好啊，主薄和县丞，吾信任汝二人才把县衙里的公务交于你们，你们倒好，不仅给我惹祸，而且还趁此机会沽名钓誉，笼络人心，尔等欲要置我于何地耶？”
姚云山这一发怒，傅游艺立马慌神了，抓捕武攸敏他可是打着姚云生的名字才敢干的，倘若姚云山翻脸不承认，傅游艺被逼背这个锅，他这小身板哪里能扛得住？
可是一时他又不知道该怎么和姚云山沟通，他目光瞟向魏生明，知道定然是这家伙搞了鬼，先下手为强给姚云生上了眼药，一时他不由得暗暗叫苦。
就在这个当口，岳峰踏步上前道：“回禀县尊大人，武攸敏要和县尊决一高下的事情的确千真万确！他有一名随从明叫尹一找上了我，我知道县尊大人您不在，便回绝了他，告诉他县尊痴迷蹴鞠几十年，其技艺高超绝非武攸敏这等纨绔公子可比！
没想到我这句话犯了忌讳，武攸敏求战不成，竟然在合宫县境内强抢民女，他这一手可是要让县尊大人藏不住身形，不得不现身！”
岳峰说到此处，顿了顿，道：“武氏势大，天下共惧，武攸敏抢了人，合宫县百姓敢怒不敢言，县衙里面，以胆略和武力见长的魏县尉躲得不见踪迹，周县丞乱了方寸没了主意，关键时候傅主薄不敢忘记县尊大人的叮咛嘱托，果断下令抓人，并暗中托人去东都请县尊大人亲临处理此事……”
岳峰口若悬河，把这件事娓娓道来，说得天衣无缝，姚云生铁青的脸略微舒缓了一些，一旁的魏生明勃然道：
“好个伶牙俐齿的文吏，汝分明是把县尊大人当幌子招祸，竟然还敢说出这么一套冠冕堂皇的话来？你可知道这武公子的身份？很快，武家就会有贵人上门，到时候你让县尊大人如何处理，倘若出了差错，县尊大人……”
魏生明话说一半，岳峰上前一步大吼一声：“住嘴！”
魏生明吓得后退了几步才站稳脚跟，岳峰趁他立足未稳勃然道：“魏大人，你等酷吏真要欺公主府无人耶？
那武氏公子在别人眼中是贵人，在公主眼中算个什么东西？在朝廷上武承嗣，武三思狐假虎威，神气活现倒也就罢了。武攸敏是个什么东西？一个武氏旁支，到了咱们合宫县，你让咱们县尊大人将他当寺里面的大佛供着？
吾告诉你魏县尉，这姓武的从东都到我们小小的合宫县，其究竟是怎么来的，是谁把他引来的，还是他别有其他的用心，这不难查出来！
咱们县尊大人与人为善，不招惹人，可是也绝对不怕事儿，你别煽风点火，县尊大人自有主意，他的心志如铁呢！”
岳峰这些话说出口，全场人人变色，傅游艺吓得双腿发软险些跪在了地上，我的天，武氏算什么东西？这话谁敢乱说？
要知道当今天下可是武氏在当道，而且武氏马上要称帝了呢！岳峰有几个脑袋敢说这种话？
魏生明也吓得不敢回嘴，岳峰这几句话如惊雷一般，把这件事捅得比天还大了，他岂敢接招？岳峰不怕死，魏生明可还珍惜自己的小命呢！
因此场面瞬间雅雀无声，大家将目光投向了姚云生，此时此刻，究竟该如何定夺就要看姚云生的了！
姚云生的神色精彩之极，一会儿阴一会儿阳，似乎内心在做着激烈的斗争，魏生明瞧着姚云生的模样，心中暗想，这姓岳的是自寻死路，姚云生这个纨绔就算再胆大妄为，今日他能装作看不见？
他心中正这么想，姚云生果然走到了岳峰的面前，他伸出手来狠狠的拍了拍岳峰的肩膀，道：“知我者，岳峰也！姓武的算个逑！汝绝不和他两立！”
“啊……”傅游艺和魏生明两人齐齐惊呼，同时瞪大了眼睛，尤其是魏生明，他简直不敢相信自己的耳朵。
我的天，姚云生怎么膨胀到这一步了？他不是一心只喜欢蹴鞠么？这一次变得如此有尿性，敢跟武氏子弟角力动手？魏生明内心彻底迷茫了。
而岳峰也终于长舒了一口气，他放手一搏，关键时候赌对了！他赌的是什么？他赌的是武则天称帝之前，李氏诸王被逼走投无路从而造反的时机应该到了。
武则天大肆屠杀李氏诸王，这个过程中牵扯到了太平公主驸马薛绍，从时间上算，差不多这个时候薛绍已经被株连遭杀了，此时的太平公主心中肯定充满怨恨，尤其是对自己的母亲。
武则天是狠人，太平公主不敢对其撒野，可是武氏其他人她就不会有顾忌了，姚云生出自太平公主府，必然也和公主有同等心思，岳峰判断正确，一举赌对了！
content_en:
Wu Youmin was thrown into jail with a single arrow from the Hegong County government office. The whole county was in a sensation. People rushed to tell each other and applauded. For a time, the reputation of Bo Fu, the new head of Hegong County, soared.
Fu Youyi was over sixty years old and had the appearance of an elder. This time he was decisive and resolute in arresting Wu Youmin. The people of Hegong County were greatly relieved. For a while, Fu Qingtian's title was even known in the county.
Fu Youyi is now in both pain and happiness. The happiness is naturally because his reputation has increased, and his next big plan can be carried out. The pain is that if he arrests someone from the Wu family, trouble will come soon. How should he deal with it then?
If he doesn't handle it well, he will fall into a state of eternal destruction, and his future in this life will be completely ruined!
Therefore, Fu Youyi has been spending time with Yue Feng these days, and Yue Feng has become his life-saving straw!
"Brother Yue, don't worry. After this incident, I will definitely recommend you to be a county captain, or I will recommend you to go to the capital to take the imperial examination, get the honor, and become a scholar from now on.
The first time I saw my brother-in-law, I knew that he was definitely not a human being. Sure enough, with his talents, he will become a pillar of the country in the future. I, someone, have the responsibility to recommend talented people to the country..."
Fu Youyi was eloquent and praised Yue Feng very highly. He said compliments about being a hero without asking where he came from, as if he was free of charge.
Yue Feng just smiled lightly and said: "Since Zhu En has gone to Dongdu, he should be back at this time! I believe that Lord County Lord must have come back as well, and I hope Lord Fu will be ready to see Lord Yao County immediately."
Fu Youyi clapped his hands and said: "That's right! I almost forgot about this important matter. When Yao County Lord comes back, he will definitely be at the Cuju court in the backyard. Brother Yue, you and I will go see the County Lord together!"
Yue Feng followed Fu Youyi to the Cuju court in the backyard, and found that the county minister Wei Shengming had arrived early. Wei Shengming stared at Fu Youyi with squinted eyes, the corners of his mouth slightly raised, and his eyes full of coldness.
Fu Youyi screamed inwardly, but before he could say anything, Yao Yunshan put his foot on the Cuju ball and kicked the ball to pieces. He said, "Okay, Lord Bo and the county magistrate. I trust you two to hand over the official affairs of the county government to you. It would be better for you to not only cause me trouble, but also take this opportunity to gain fame and win over people. Where do you want to put me?"
Fu Youyi immediately panicked when Yao Yunshan became angry. He only dared to arrest Wu Youmin in the name of Yao Yunsheng. If Yao Yunshan turned his back and refused to admit it, Fu Youyi was forced to take the blame. How could his small body be able to bear it?
But for a moment, he didn't know how to communicate with Yao Yunshan. He glanced at Wei Shengming and knew that this guy must be the one behind it. He preemptively gave Yao Yunsheng eye drops. For a moment, he couldn't help but secretly complain.
At this moment, Yue Feng stepped forward and said: "Reporting to the Lord County Lord, it is absolutely true that Wu Youmin wants to compete with the County Lord! One of his followers named Yin Yi came to me. I knew that you were not here, Lord County Lord, so I turned him down and told him that the County Lord has been obsessed with Cuju for decades, and his superb skills are definitely not comparable to that of a dandy like Wu Youmin!
Unexpectedly, my words violated a taboo. Wu Youmin failed in his request for a fight and actually robbed a girl in Hegong County. His move was such that the county magistrate could not hide his presence and had to show up! "
When Yue Feng said this, he paused and said: "The Wu family is powerful and the whole world is afraid of it. Wu Youmin robbed people. The people of Hegong County dared not speak out. In the county government, Wei County Lieutenant, who is known for his courage and force, disappeared without a trace. Zhouxian Cheng was confused and had no idea. At the critical moment, Fu Zhubo did not dare to forget the County Lord’s instructions, decisively ordered the arrest, and secretly asked someone to go to Dongdu to ask the County Lord to deal with the matter in person..."
Yue Feng was eloquent and spoke about this matter flawlessly. Yao Yunsheng's livid face relaxed slightly, and Wei Shengming beside him said angrily:
"You are such a sharp-tongued civil servant. You are clearly using the county magistrate as a cover to invite trouble, and you dare to say such high-sounding words? Do you know the identity of Mr. Wu? Soon, a noble person from the Wu family will come to your door. When the time comes, you will ask the county magistrate how to deal with it. If something goes wrong, the county magistrate..."
Wei Shengming was mid-sentence when Yue Feng stepped forward and shouted: "Shut up!"
Wei Shengming was so frightened that he took a few steps back before he regained his footing. Yue Feng took advantage of his unsteady footing and said angrily: "Master Wei, are you really going to bully the princess's house to have no one in the house?
So Mr. Wu is a nobleman in the eyes of others, but what is he in the eyes of the princess? At the court, Wu Chengsi and Wu Sansi thought that the fox was pretending to be the tiger, and that was all. What is Wu Youmin? When a branch of the Wu family arrives in our Hegong County, do you want our county magistrate to enshrine him as a giant Buddha in the temple?
Let me tell you Wei County Lieutenant, this man surnamed Wu came from Dongdu to our small Hegong County. How did he come? Who lured him here? Or does he have other ulterior motives? It is not difficult to find out!
Our County Master is kind to others and does not provoke others, but he is definitely not afraid of trouble. Don't fan the flames. The County Master has his own ideas and his will is as strong as iron! "
When Yue Feng said these words, everyone in the audience changed their expressions. Fu Youyi was so frightened that her legs became weak and she almost knelt on the ground. Oh my god, who is the Wu family? Who dares to say this nonsense?
You must know that the Wu family is in power today, and the Wu family is about to become emperor! How many heads in Yue Feng dare to say such a thing?
Wei Shengming was too frightened to reply. Yue Feng's words were like thunder. They made this matter bigger than the sky. How could he dare to accept it? Yue Feng is not afraid of death, but Wei Shengming still cherishes his own life!
Therefore, the scene was silent for a moment, and everyone turned their attention to Yao Yunsheng. At this moment, it is up to Yao Yunsheng to make a decision!
Yao Yunsheng's expression was extremely exciting, sometimes yin and then yang, as if he was fighting a fierce struggle in his heart. Wei Shengming looked at Yao Yunsheng's appearance and thought to himself, this man named Yue is seeking his own death. No matter how bold and arrogant Yao Yunsheng is, how can he pretend not to see it today?
Just as he was thinking this, Yao Yunsheng actually walked up to Yue Feng. He stretched out his hand and patted Yue Feng's shoulder hard, saying: "The one who knows me is Yue Feng! The one with the surname Wu is not the same! You will never stand up to him!"
"Ah..." Fu Youyi and Wei Shengming both exclaimed, their eyes widening at the same time, especially Wei Shengming, who couldn't believe his ears.
Oh my God, how did Yao Yunsheng expand to this point? Doesn’t he just like Cuju? You have become so urinary this time. Do you dare to wrestle with a disciple of the Wu family? Wei Shengming was completely confused.
And Yue Feng finally breathed a sigh of relief. He gave it a try and made the right bet at the critical moment! What was he betting on? What he was betting on was that before Wu Zetian became emperor, the time would come for the Li kings to be cornered and rebel.
Wu Zetian massacred the kings of the Li family, and in this process, Princess Taiping's consort Xue Shao was involved. Judging from the time, Xue Shao had been implicated and killed at about this time. Princess Taiping at this time must be full of resentment, especially towards her mother.
Wu Zetian was a ruthless person, and Princess Taiping did not dare to act wildly against her, but she would not have scruples about other members of the Wu family. Yao Yunsheng came from Princess Taiping's house, so he must have the same thoughts as the princess. Yue Feng's judgment was correct, and he made the right bet in one fell swoop!
title_en: Chapter 23 The bet was right Chapter 24 Someone from the Wu family came
